missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Nominative subject. 'Сообщение' stays in the nominative case as the neuter subject that arrived. 'Важное' is the agreeing neuter adjective.
Strategic focus: Accusative object. 'Сообщение' is the accusative direct object of 'получил'; neuter nouns match nominative and accusative. 'Твоё' agrees in the neuter.
Strategic focus: Prepositional location. 'В сообщении' uses the prepositional form 'сообщении' after 'в' to show where the mistake is. 'Этом' agrees in the neuter prepositional.
Strategic focus: Genitive of possession. 'Сообщения' is the genitive form expressing 'the meaning of the message'. A natural way to link two nouns.
Strategic focus: Dative with preposition. 'Сообщению' is the dative form after 'к' marking what the photo is attached to. A common messaging expression.
Strategic focus: Instrumental of means. 'Сообщением' is the instrumental case, the means used to reply. 'Коротким' agrees in the neuter instrumental.
Strategic focus: Prepositional case. 'О сообщении' uses the prepositional form after 'о' to express talking about the message. 'Новом' agrees in the neuter prepositional.
Strategic focus: Nominative plural. 'Сообщения' is the nominative plural subject that arrive. 'Новые' is the agreeing plural adjective.
Strategic focus: Genitive plural. 'Сообщений' is the genitive plural after 'нет' to express absence. 'Новых' agrees in the genitive plural.
Strategic focus: Nominative description. 'Сообщение' is nominative as the subject. 'Длинное' is the agreeing neuter predicate adjective, intensified by 'слишком'. A clean descriptive model.
